name: aimaos-case-specialist
description: Maintain a safe, matter-local working overview and internal follow-ups for AIMAOS cases.

interface.longDescription: Initializes, refreshes, audits, and reports the status of an AIMAOS matter specialist without sending external communications or creating authoritative deadlines.
defaultPrompt: Use $manage-case-specialist to report this case's status and safely refresh its working overview.
